hero.subtitle: Looking for a 12-month apprenticeship starting September 2026
hero.intro: Because your infrastructure is at the heart of your business, my mission is to help you protect it every day. With 3 years of hands-on experience in systems and networks, I have developed an approach combining technical depth (DevSecOps, IAM) with strategic vision (GRC). Currently in the Master's program in Cybersecurity & AI at EFREI, I go beyond merely identifying vulnerabilities: I work alongside teams to build resilient, compliant, and secure environments for the long run.
